title: スーパークリーク登場！

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff, puff… Almost… at the… finish line…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer is waiting for me there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a variety of relationships that can exist between an Umamusume and a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Hey! What's with this time?! I know you can do better than that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Right! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Hmm, these aren't exactly the results we were aiming for. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Um, I thought that might be the case as I was running…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We, on the other hand…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Finish!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, a new record! My time's slightly better than before! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you! You're the reason why any of this is possible.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Who's a good trainer?! You are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is how we've always been. Not a hint of strictness.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Pat, pat. What a good trainer you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Sorry, it just feels so nice patting you.
choice_data_list: Is it okay for us to have this kind of relationship?
Is it okay for us to have this kind of relationship?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean?
choice_data_list: We're way more laid-back than the others.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Laid-back? Hmm, I guess I see what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But this is what works for us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There's one thing more important than anything else when it comes to us running together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Whether or not you feel the urge to coddle! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As long as we both do, then we're peachy. That applies to everyone to some extent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek is a bundle of maternal instincts. She was the one who actually chose me—that's how our partnership began.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I don't think we're anything like the others, but I like to think that this is what makes our bond unique.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get our Twinkle Series started.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There's a long road ahead of us, but I'm sure we'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll be watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We discuss our future goals.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, we'll need to start with the Classics, right? The Satsuki Sho, the Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's everyone's dream to be a Classics trainer, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: At the very least, winning one would be great. All of them, if possible.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want you to have these victories, my precious trainer.
choice_data_list: But you're the one running the races…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want you to have all of the glory. So please, let me help you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If you're happy, I'm happy. ♪ Okay, let's roll our sleeves up and get to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like something doesn't quite line up. Still, thus marks the start of our Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's an Umamusume with a bright future ahead of her, while I'm just a novice trainer. We're in totally different leagues.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to focus on improving my own abilities if I want any chance of leading her to success. Our path to the top will be a long one.
